# Sandbox bridge probe

Version 0.1.2. Install as a community package and enable it in a session.
Choose Bridge reader or Bridge input from Plugin pages and grant each page's
labelled capabilities. The two specs share a classic-script resource root.
Bridge reader keeps the host input box beneath the page; Bridge input declares
`composer: false`, so the page hides it and Stop moves to the session header.

The page displays public story, human input context and supported interactions.
Submit sends a player action, Answer submits the displayed interaction, Write
note invokes this package's manual runtime through proposal commit, Stop calls
the host abort and Open notes opens its own panel. Refused submissions retain
the draft. Code approval and page consent are separate.

Page error throws an uncaught exception; Rejected promise, Rejected promise from
timer and Rejected async handler cause unhandled rejections from their respective
callbacks. Ignore heartbeat stops responding to probes without freezing the
whole browser. Navigate retires the document. Fill viewport tests frame
containment with a fixed, high-z-index body that scrolls inside its own frame;
the root prevents the body's overflow from propagating to the viewport.
These modes make no network requests.

The text and stage toggle, permissions and Stop remain outside the page,
including at narrow widths. A page that fails returns to the read view with a
plain notice; choosing the page again retries with a fresh frame after the
current content consent is checked. Late callbacks cannot restore a retired
attempt. Normal runtime refusals leave the page usable.

Consent persists on this device and covers the entire resolved spec and all
published bytes. The selected page, page drafts and ports last only for this visit.
Changed content asks again. Server handlers and schemas stay outside the public
root; the fixture has no dependencies or paid model calls.
